name: Internet Health Pro
release_gate: one shared monitoring engine per plugin process
native ICMP latency with honest TCP-connect, DNS lookup and HTTPS response timing labels
multi-signal outage detection with two-cycle confirmation
ICMP-blocked network fallback without false 100% probe loss
user-adjustable latency, jitter and probe-loss thresholds
manual-only throughput test capped at approximately 10 MB per run
clean Windows and macOS live network smoke
official Elgato Stream Deck CLI validation
deterministic Rat Art and marketplace kit preflight
final_boundary: Install the exact packaged .streamDeckPlugin in Stream Deck and physically observe live key rendering through a disconnect/reconnect and one manual speed test before Marketplace submission.
qa_note: Final ship audit found a platform-specific explicit ICMP family command issue after the prior green gate: macOS IPv4 must use plain ping without Linux -4, while Linux IPv6 must explicitly use -6. Source is patched with deterministic Windows/macOS/Linux command tests and is awaiting a fresh full release gate before READY_TO_SHIP is restored.
